visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with styled black hair and a black t-shirt stands before a plain grey background, holding a red square makeup palette closely to the camera. He smiles enthusiastically, his eyes squinting with joy. (2) He opens the palette to reveal five pans of eyeshadow and two small applicators. He uses a makeup brush to pick up a light golden-brown shade and applies it carefully to his upper eyelid while glancing into the mirror inside the palette lid. (3) The man continues the application, blending a pinkish-brown shade into the crease. He gestures broadly with his hands and laughs, looking directly at the camera with expressive facial movements. (4) He demonstrates the application of a shimmer shade to the center of his lid using the brush, then switches to a darker brown for the outer corners and lash line. Various graphical text overlays appear around him. (5) Finally, he applies a light shimmer to his under-eye area and draws an eyeliner wing. He closes the red palette, holds it up near his face, and waves at the camera with a bright, satisfied smile as the video cuts to a logo screen.
